about: Upstream test failures recorded on untouched upstream 2.1.1 with this machine's bun 1.3.14 (docs/plans/2026-10-16-phase-1-baseline.txt). scripts/mittr/test-baseline.mjs runs each stage of the root test script and fails only on a failure not listed here. `file` is relative to the folder the stage runs in.

failures.test: a release bump packs workspace dependencies at the new version after a frozen install
failures.why: bun pm pack packs the old version under bun 1.3.14

failures.test: checked-in SDK examples > all shipped bundles match their source and current SDK
failures.why: bundle hash differs with the bundler of bun 1.3.14

failures.test: Streaming heal > healing a long streamed block full of underscores stays fast
Many short paragraphs > block math and disclosures after thousands of paragraphs render in linear work (assistant text)
Many short paragraphs > block math and disclosures after thousands of paragraphs render in linear work (user text)
Long paragraphs > the data dump from the report opens without the quadratic rescan
VS Code OpenCode upgrades > uses the configured registry and Basic headers for the v2 package version
VS Code OpenCode upgrades > reports invalid registry configuration without a public-registry fallback
plugin metadata uses the shared resolver with credential-safe URLs
createVSCodeGitAPI network operations > a slow transfer stays running past the bridge timeout and settles with the host answer
the WebSocket forwarder > ends every socket when it is closed
failures.why: flaky: fails in a full run, passes alone

failures.test: SSH integration suite uses an isolated server home
failures.why: the test writes its git identities under its own HOME and expects OPENCHAMBER_DATA_DIR to be unset; every isolated run sets it, and the test passes when it is unset
